result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed but has a few minor layout and content issues, including a truncated restaurant name and potential accessibility concerns with icon contrast.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Either shorten the name or allow it to wrap to a second line to display the full name.

issues.description: The heart icons on the restaurant cards have a thin white outline which might be hard to see against some background images.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle drop shadow or a slightly thicker outline to improve visibility.

issues.description: The 'See all' links are right-aligned but don't have consistent spacing relative to the section headers.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent vertical alignment and spacing between the section headers and the 'See all' links.
